title: Nvidia’s Hugging Face Deal Is a Hedge against Broadcom’s Custom Silicon Threat
title_zh: 英伟达的拥抱交易是对博通定制芯片威胁的对冲
summary: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has officially committed billions on AI developer platform Hugging Face for a $12.9 billion. The deal signifies the chipmaker’s move beyond hardware and up the AI stack.
summary_zh: NVIDIA 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）已正式向 AI 开发者平台 Hugging Face 投入数十亿美元，总金额为 129 亿美元。这笔交易标志着芯片制造商超越硬件并向人工智能堆栈迈进。

title: KKR (KKR) Bets On Data Centres, Home Services And Healthcare With New Deals
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 通过新交易押注数据中心、家庭服务和医疗保健
summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) is ramping up activity in digital infrastructure, home services and healthcare with a series of new deals. The firm agreed to acquire a majority stake in global data centre operator ST Telemedia Global Data Centres in recent days.
summary_zh: KKR（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）正在通过一系列新交易加强数字基础设施、家庭服务和医疗保健领域的活动。该公司近日同意收购全球数据中心运营商 ST Telemedia 全球数据中心的多数股权。

title: What Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A)'s Tech Tilt and Taylor Morrison Deal Means For Shareholders
title_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司 (BRK.A) 的 Tech Tilt 和泰勒莫里森交易对股东意味着什么
summary: Berkshire Hathaway recently shifted from being a net seller to a net buyer of stocks under CEO Greg Abel, ramping up purchases including a roughly US$38.00 billion Alphabet stake and acquiring homebuilder Taylor Morrison for about US$6.80 billion.
summary_zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司最近在首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔 (Greg Abel) 的领导下从股票净卖家转变为股票净买家，加大了购买力度，其中包括约 380 亿美元的 Alphabet 股份，并以约 68 亿美元收购了房屋建筑商泰勒·莫里森 (Taylor Morrison)。

title: Blackstone (BX) Joins $3 Billion Debt Deal As It Readies Hotel IPO
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 加入 30 亿美元债务交易，准备酒店 IPO
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) joined Waymo’s first major debt financing, a US$3b deal that marks the autonomous driving company’s debut in the debt market.
summary_zh: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 加入了 Waymo 的首笔重大债务融资，这笔 30 亿美元的交易标志着这家自动驾驶公司首次在债务市场上亮相。

title: Waymo raises $3 billion in first-ever debt deal with Pimco, Blackstone
title_zh: Waymo 通过与 Pimco 和 Blackstone 的首笔债务交易筹集了 30 亿美元
summary: The Alphabet unit is working with Goldman Sachs to finalize the loan, which could price at more than 500 basis points over the benchmark
summary_zh: Alphabet 部门正在与高盛合作敲定这笔贷款，贷款定价可能比基准高出 500 个基点以上
